plans.rationale: Sequencing/over-the-top has come up repeatedly in recent lessons and is the current coaching focus, so this plan builds the new sequencing feel progressively before testing it under pressure.

weekly_structure.theme: Isolate the feel with slow, exaggerated reps of step-change-of-direction and pump-drill.
Add speed to the drills and start transferring the sequencing feel into full swings.
Pressure-test the new sequencing with a target/scoring game.
